techniques.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/skills_sidecar/mod.rs:248 writes SKILL.md per bound connector with no removal path anywhere (no other code references the personas-connector- prefix for deletion); install is decided per run, retention by nobody - creation names no reaper

src-tauri/src/engine/project_tracking/consolidator.rs:561 claims a $HOME CLAUDE.md no longer reaches the pulse turn, but on Windows tempfile/temp_dir resolves under %USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Temp, so the unbounded upward walk still reaches $HOME; the scratch cwd at :574 is positionally inside the span and the loaded set is never asserted

pairs.registryProposal: workspace-ancestry-isolation could name the platform trap: on Windows the OS temp dir is a descendant of the user profile, so 'run in an empty temp dir' does not empty the span on the unbounded-walk host; only a dir outside $HOME (or a loaded-set assertion) does
